purpose: Historical observations and sourced event context; the manual rainfall series supports only a retrospective next-record measurement benchmark. No verified labels support flood prediction, and the benchmark is excluded from the disaster assessment.
reuse_policy: NWDP resource pages identify the CSV resources as 'Other (Open)'. The NWDP copyright policy permits accurate reproduction with prominent attribution, subject to third-party rights. Preserve this source attribution and check current portal terms before external redistribution.
timestamp_policy: Local source strings are parsed as day-first because the stored examples use DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM. Source timezone is not documented; values are not timezone-converted.
spatial_policy: The CSVs contain latitude/longitude columns, but these are not mapped or used in spatial joins here. The inspected portal descriptions do not establish a datum/CRS or positional accuracy for these station coordinates.

event_sources.title: CWC Study Report: Kerala Floods of August 2018 (reproduced as an annex in a KSDMA report)
event_sources.publisher: Central Water Commission, Hydrological Studies Organisation; hosted in a Kerala Government/KSDMA report
event_sources.publication_date: September 2018 (CWC report, as cited in the host document)
event_sources.license: No dataset license for the report facts was found; quote/attribute source and avoid reproducing the report itself.
event_sources.usable_facts: The annex states IMD-reported Kerala rainfall 2,346.6 mm from 1 June to 19 August 2018 versus 1,649.5 mm normal (+42%); it records flood onset toward late July and severe flooding in 13 of 14 districts.
event_sources.relation_to_local_series: No overlap: local manual rainfall ends in 2014; the local 2021–2025 observations begin after this 2018 event. Timeline is context only, not joined labels.

event_sources.title: Government Order: flood/landslide-affected villages, October 2021
event_sources.publisher: Disaster Management Department, Government of Kerala / KSDMA-hosted official order
event_sources.publication_date: 2022-02-03; order references severe calamities from 2021-10-12 to 2021-10-25
event_sources.license: Official government order; no separate reuse license identified. Attribute source and use factual summary only.
event_sources.usable_facts: The order declares 305 villages in 39 taluks flood/landslide affected after extreme rainfall and flooding during 2021-10-12 through 2021-10-25.
event_sources.relation_to_local_series: Some 2021–2025 local records overlap the date window. The order does not map specific station observations to outcomes, so the overlap is contextual and not a supervised label.
